spans.s:
उञ्छ n. (-ञ्छं) Gathering grains.
 E. उछि to glean, and घञ् aff.

उञ्छन n. (-नं) Gathering grains of corn in market places, &c. gleaning.
E. उछि to glean, ल्युट् aff.

उञ्छवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) A gleaner, one who lives by gleaning. E.
उञ्छ and वृत्ति practice.

उञ्छशिल n. (-लं) Gleaning corn or grains.
 E. उञ्छ gathering grain, and
शिल gleaning corn.

उञ्छ-शील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) One who lives by gleaning, &c.
 E. उञ्छ and शील who practices.
